programs.name: National Quantum Initiative
programs.summary: Created by the National Quantum Initiative Act (Pub. L. 115-368), which coordinates federal quantum research across NIST, NSF and DOE and set up the DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Centers. Executive Order 14413 (June 2026) orders an updated national strategy.
programs.note: The $1.2 billion figure is widely reported but wasn't stated on the source page checked.

programs.name: National Quantum Strategy
programs.summary: Ten-year plan with five quantum missions, including quantum computers and networks, quantum sensing and navigation, run through UKRI and the National Quantum Computing Centre.

programs.name: Quantum Flagship and Quantum Europe Strategy
programs.summary: The EU's research flagship for quantum technologies. The Quantum Europe Strategy (July 2025) aims to make the EU a quantum leader by 2030 and announced a Quantum Act.
programs.note: The €1 billion Flagship figure is widely reported but wasn't confirmed from the page checked.

programs.name: Action Concept for Quantum Technologies
programs.summary: Federal plan adopted by the cabinet in April 2023, aiming for a universal quantum computer of at least 100 qubits by 2026.

programs.name: National Strategy for Quantum Technologies
programs.summary: Announced by President Macron in January 2021, covering quantum computing, sensing, communications and enabling technologies.
programs.source_name: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research

programs.name: Quantum Delta NL
programs.funding: €615 million from the National Growth Fund
programs.summary: National program for quantum computing, networks and sensing, built around hubs in Delft, Amsterdam, Leiden, Eindhoven and Twente.

programs.name: National Quantum Strategy
programs.summary: Launched in January 2023 with missions in quantum computing, quantum communications and quantum sensors.

programs.name: National Quantum Strategy
programs.funding: A$940 million with Queensland for PsiQuantum (2024)
programs.summary: Strategy published in 2023. In 2024 the federal and Queensland governments committed A$940 million to PsiQuantum to build a fault-tolerant quantum computer in Brisbane.
programs.source_name: Department of Industry, Science and Resources

programs.name: National Quantum Mission
programs.summary: Approved by the Union Cabinet in April 2023 to build intermediate-scale quantum computers, quantum communication, sensing and materials, through four thematic hubs.

programs.name: Quantum Science and Technology Strategy
programs.summary: Plan from the Ministry of Science and ICT to make Korea a quantum economy hub by 2035, with public and private investment.

programs.name: National Quantum Strategy
programs.summary: Announced in May 2024 to fund quantum research, talent and a national quantum processor initiative.

us_actions.title: National Quantum Initiative Act
us_actions.summary: Set up the National Quantum Initiative to coordinate federal quantum research and education, and the DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Centers.

us_actions.title: CHIPS and Science Act
us_actions.summary: Broad science law that includes quantum provisions, such as quantum networking and workforce programs at NSF and DOE.

us_actions.title: Quantum Computing Cybersecurity Preparedness Act
us_actions.summary: Requires federal agencies to plan the move of their systems to post-quantum cryptography.

us_actions.title: Post-quantum cryptography standards (FIPS 203, 204 and 205)
us_actions.summary: NIST's first finalized post-quantum encryption and signature standards, based on ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA.

us_actions.title: Ushering in the Next Frontier of Quantum Innovation
us_actions.summary: Orders an updated National Quantum Strategy within 180 days, an effort to deliver a quantum computer for scientific discovery to a DOE facility, five-year quantum sensing and networking plans, and workforce and supply chain measures.

us_actions.summary: Reauthorizes the National Quantum Initiative Act.

us_actions.summary: Expands DOE's quantum research program and reauthorizes the National Quantum Information Science Research Centers through FY2030.
